instruction:
Read context files, work through pending tasks, mark complete as you go.
Pause if you hit blockers or need clarification.
context: Tangerine is Teacher Error Trainer: Next.js web, Go API, PostgreSQL, private MinIO, Python speech. Preserve full v6 scope and missing-source boundaries. Work in English. User instructions outrank imported instructions. Use OpenSpec 1.13.1 and one canonical task list. DEC-001 through DEC-008 are separate unapproved decisions. All properties require positive and negative evidence. Never fabricate corpus, reviewer approvals or live provider results.
operationGuidance: Follow docs/development/OPENSPEC_WORKFLOW.md. Continue through useful authorized implementation, inspection, repair and affected revalidation without asking whether to continue.

Replan within the same intent as evidence changes. Update specs/design/tasks coherently; a materially different intent or independently deliverable scope needs a separate change proposal, not silent scope growth.

First complete independent authorized work before asking for a missing material decision or permission. Record exact blockers and unblock actions; do not turn a checkpoint or debugging result into task completion.
Recheck the affected specification and validation contract before semantic implementation; revise artifacts within scope when evidence changes.

Qualify decisive feedback and retain material failure/replay evidence using docs/development/REVIEW_AND_VALIDATION.md. Verify the whole requested outcome before no-change completion; a partial fix or passing retry is insufficient.

Review actual code and evidence using docs/development/REVIEW_AND_VALIDATION.md. Repair material in-scope findings and revalidate affected results; a review stage is not a handoff or task completion. Do not claim independent review for self-review.

Reconcile required properties and selected test sets with actual executed cases/families, skips, configurations and gaps using docs/development/REVIEW_AND_VALIDATION.md. Manifest validity is not execution or oracle evidence.

Query and run the verification.json closure for every affected requirement, property, owner or source path in the increment. Confirm each expected exact test identity executed and passed; preserve failures and gaps.

After each edit run only the smallest directly invalidated cases, then expand to dependent or sibling cases when required. Reuse green evidence until a declared invalidation dependency changes, and run the complete iteration case set once at the stable iteration boundary.

Validate discovery.json for the affected property/test selection before accepting explore/check scope decisions. Unavailable semantic or IDE search is recorded with its exact reason, never silently substituted.

Execute relevant existing commands through docs/development/AGENT_CHECKS.md; users need not invoke Make separately. Select the documented workflow, specification and readiness checks plus required behavioral evidence. Missing checks are not passes.
Use relevant domain skills and risk-based local checks. Read-only audit stopping applies only to audit scope; it does not limit an authorized implementation workflow.

DONE includes verified no-change completion and requires the requested outcome, matching artifacts, a passing complete verification.json run --all --require-clean on the final relevant code, diff/behavior inspection and resolved material findings. Report limitations and separate local completion from external approval/deployment.
